item.title: State Investment and Entrepreneurs in an International Setting
item.content:encoded:
David Ahlstrom, Hong Kong Metropolitan University

Gongming Qian, Shantou University

Jiatao Li, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Bin Liu, Xiamen University

This special issue seeks papers exploring how different types and roles of state investment affect entrepreneurship internationally. The issue welcomes both theoretical work grounded in established frameworks and innovative new theories, alongside empirical research on strategy and entrepreneurship in contexts where governments and related institutions play more active roles.

Submissions should provide rigorous analysis of state investment mechanisms and their entrepreneurial implications across different countries and institutional settings.

Appel publié par Asia Pacific Journal of Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • State investment forms and functions
  • Entrepreneurship across countries
  • Government participation in business
  • Strategy and entrepreneurship
  • Institutional influence on entrepreneurship
